chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'If one finds for the expiation only one man or two men, then let it be repeated upon them until ten are completed; he gives them [food] today, then gives them [food] tomorrow.'
ai.seo_question: How to fulfill an oath expiation if you only have a few people to feed?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the flexibility in fulfilling the ten-person feeding requirement of kaffarat al-yamin, permitting the repetition of feeding the same individuals to reach the total count. It highlights the practical ease granted by the Ahl al-Bayt, allowing the expiation to be distributed over multiple days rather than requiring a single massive gathering. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on accessibility and the removal of undue hardship in acts of worship.
